info.description: Accounts are payroll connections made through Link.

request.description:
Create a connection session and return a `link` URL that launches the frontend experience.

Session links expire after one hour. A new session link can be created at any time by creating another session for the active verification.

<Note>This endpoint is for payroll and banking verifications only.</Note>

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

request.description:
Creates a new payroll, banking, or Doc VOI verification without requiring the user to reconnect or upload additional documents.

For payroll and banking, a valid connection must already exist. For Doc VOI, the new report is generated from the user's existing uploaded documents.
